name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Wee.leaf_trapdoor_norm
title: Leaf trapdoor with its norm: phi(w)=0 gives A_phi - G = B R_phi - G with rows of R_phi of norm <= errBound
statement: Over Z_q[X]/(X^N+1), with binary gadget decompositions, a 0/1 attribute w, the block identity B T_B[i,j] + W_i T_W[j] = delta_ij G of the l-succinct LWE trapdoor, and input trapdoors R T_W[j] - sum_i w_i T_B[i,j] with entries of norm <= E: for every NAND circuit phi with phi(w) = 0 there is R_phi with EvalF(phi, A) - G = B R_phi - G and every row of R_phi of norm <= errBound (k N) E phi. This is the short -G trapdoor of the leaf lemma (C1) of the witness-tree WE candidate.
